description: Nudges toward pstack:poteto-mode as the default entry point for non-trivial engineering tasks. Overridable by direct user instructions or CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, per the injected text itself. Set env var PSTACK_DISABLE_SESSION_HOOK=1 to disable this hook entirely. Set PSTACK_SESSION_HOOK_FILE to an absolute path to inject that file's text instead. The hook also tells the model not to start arena unless the user asks; set PSTACK_ENABLE_ARENA=1 to drop that line.

hooks.command: [ "$PSTACK_DISABLE_SESSION_HOOK" = "1" ] || { f="$PSTACK_SESSION_HOOK_FILE"; [ -r "$f" ] || f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start-context.md"; cat "$f"; if [ "$PSTACK_ENABLE_ARENA" != "1" ]; then printf '\n%s\n' 'Do not start the arena skill on your own. Run it only when the user explicitly asks for it (/arena, arena this). This overrides any playbook or skill that says arena is mandatory or recommended; do the work directly instead.'; fi; }
